text: Professional level and duration of studyUndergraduate programs in regular institutions of higher learning, belonging to the category of economics, have a duration of four years and confer a Bachelor of Economics degree.Discipline positioningBased on mathematics, statistics, accounting and other disciplines, combined with social science thinking, this study focuses on the economic behaviors of individuals and society, market mechanisms, macroeconomic operations (such as GDP growth, employment, inflation, etc.) and policy impacts.Development historyFrom classical economics (Adam Smith's "The Wealth of Nations") to neoclassical economics, Keynesianism, and then to modern econometrics, behavioral economics, etc., the disciplinary system has continuously integrated mathematical models and empirical analysis, gradually improving.Training objectivesCultivate compound and innovative talents with a solid foundation in economic theory, who master modern economic analysis methods and can engage in economic policy research, data analysis, business management, teaching and research, etc. in government departments, enterprises and institutions, financial institutions, research institutes, etc. Students are required to possessThe ability to explain real-world problems by applying economic theories;Proficient in using econometric tools such as Python and Stata for economic data analysis;International perspective and interdisciplinary thinking (such as analyzing economic phenomena in combination with sociology and psychology).
